name: Yen
source:
Born in Suzhou.
She studied dance at the Beijing Dance Academy and came to Hong Kong to become a ballroom dance teacher.
She met and married Breeze, but got involved in Breeze's fixed bout scandal, and her parents persuaded her to divorce.
She then met Lung in Macau and started dating him.
In 2011, Lung was being chased by debt collectors, and she sought refuge alone at her parents' house.
On the way, she was kidnapped by the Over Heaven Society and rescued by Lai.
She was good friends with her student Wei and was kidnapped by the Raksasa with her when she went to Macau to meet her in 2014.
She was released in a hostage exchange with Lai, after which Yvet and her team freed Lai and Wei as well.
After the case was solved, she helped the Red Flower Society get information from her student Sammi.
